catalyst.name: Stats for All Refit, Cascade Point Refit, Repulsor Brace Refit, Loose Change Refit
catalyst.description:
Grants the Stats For All trait:
Upon damaging 3 Separate Enemies within 3 seconds of each, for 10 seconds:
• 35 Handling and Reload Speed
• 10 Stability and Range
• 5% increased Damage Falloff Distance
• 0.95x Reload Duration Multiplier
Buff duration cannot be refreshed.
Grants the Cascade Point trait:
After scoring a kill or multiple Precision Hits within 5 seconds of each with a different weapon:
Readying this weapon reduces its Firing Delay for 2.5 seconds.
Firing Delay is reduced by 30% on SMGs and Machine Guns and by 40% on other archetypes.
Precision Hits requried per weapon archetype:
• Bows, Linear Fusion/Sniper Rifles, Shotguns, Glaive Projectiles: 2 hits
• Hand Cannons, Scout Rifles: 4 hits
• Auto/Trace/Pulse Rifles, SMGs, Machine Guns, Sidearms: 6 hits
Grants the Repulsor Brace trait:
Kills against Void Debuffed enemies grant a 45 HP Void Overshield for 8 seconds (12 with Echo of Persistence).
Grants the Loose Change trait:
Applying an Elemental Debuff grants the following benefits for 9 seconds:
• 50 Reload Speed and 20 Aim Assist
• 20% decreased ADS Movement Speed Penalty
Buff can be activated while stowed.
